basic_details.job_title: AMU Assistant Professor (Tashreeh-wa-Munafeual Aza) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Aligarh Muslim University (AMU), Uttar Pradesh, has invited applications for the post of Assistant Professor (Temporary) under Advt No. 08 / 2026. Applications are accepted online until 14 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online Mode at the Careers Portal.

qualification.education_qualification: Postgraduate degree in the concerned specialty or subject from a recognized university, included in the Second Schedule of the Indian Medicine Central Council Act, 1970 or recognized under section 35 of the Act, with valid State or Central/National registration (as per Gazette Notification No. 764 dated 26th September, 2024). The candidate must have qualified the National Teachers Eligibility Test conducted by NCISM. No teaching experience is required.
qualification.details: Qualification: Postgraduate degree in the concerned specialty or subject from a recognized university, included in the Second Schedule of the Indian Medicine Central Council Act, 1970 or recognized under section 35 of the Act; Valid registration with the concerned State Board or Council, or a valid Central or National registration certificate issued by the Board of Ethics and Registration for Indian System of Medicine, NCISM (not applicable for teachers of non-medical qualifications); For the specialties in the notice table, a Postgraduate degree in Unani medicine in the related specialty listed in column three is considered eligible; Qualified in the National Teachers Eligibility Test conducted by the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine Experience: No teaching experience is required | Other conditions: | Post is reserved for the 'OH' category of PwD candidates PwD applicants must have at least 40% of the relevant disability, with a Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I) Indian Nationals, including OCI Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955, may apply Candidates with an NCISM Teacher's Code must provide it at the time of the interview New candidates must present the NTET AYUSH certificate along with the scorecard

how_to_apply: Fill the Application Form only in Online Mode at the Careers Portal https://careers.amuonline.ac.in by 14.11.2026.
Pay the non-refundable Processing Fee of Rs. 500/- online at the Careers Portal; PwD candidates uploading an authentic Disability Certificate are exempted.
Take a printout of the PDF of the Application Form on A-4 size paper, sign it and paste a recent front-facing photograph.
Attach attested copies of all relevant documents to the printout.
Send the form by post, writing the post applied for, advertisement number and date on the top-left of the cover.
Hard copy must reach the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Unani Medicine, Ajmal Khan Tibbiya College, AMU, Aligarh 202001 by 21.11.2026, 04.00 PM.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for the interview Separate Application Forms are needed for each post under a different Serial Number Qualifications and eligibility are reckoned as on the last date of submission of the Application Form Amendment or corrigendum, if any, will be published only on the Careers Portal Help Desk: +91-571-2700920 (Extension 1178) on working days during office hours

content_sections.heading: AMU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 08 / 2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download AMU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Postgraduate degree in the concerned specialty or subject from a recognized university, included in the Second Schedule of the Indian Medicine Central Council Act, 1970 or recognized under section 35 of the Act; Valid registration with the concerned State Board or Council, or a valid Central or National registration certificate issued by the Board of Ethics and Registration for Indian System of Medicine, NCISM (not applicable for teachers of non-medical qualifications); For the specialties in the notice table, a Postgraduate degree in Unani medicine in the related specialty listed in column three is considered eligible; Qualified in the National Teachers Eligibility Test conducted by the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine Experience: No teaching experience is required Other conditions: Post is reserved for the 'OH' category of PwD candidates PwD applicants must have at least 40% of the relevant disability, with a Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I) Indian Nationals, including OCI Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955, may apply Candidates with an NCISM Teacher's Code must provide it at the time of the interview New candidates must present the NTET AYUSH certificate along with the scorecard

content_sections.heading: How Will AMU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny and short-listing of applications Interview The University may constitute a Committee to scrutinize applications and short-list applicants Call letters for interview will be sent only to short-listed applicants Interview will be notified separately and held in the Chamber of the Dean, Faculty of Unani Medicine, AMU, Aligarh List of eligible candidates will be displayed at https://amu.ac.in/faculties/faculty-of-unani-medicine/notice-and-circular Disability claim will be examined by the University Medical Board before the appointment letter is issued

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: High School Certificate from a Recognized Board Mark sheet and Degree of Graduation Certificate etc. No Objection Certificate from the present employer if employed at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for the interview Separate Application Forms are needed for each post under a different Serial Number Qualifications and eligibility are reckoned as on the last date of submission of the Application Form Amendment or corrigendum, if any, will be published only on the Careers Portal Help Desk: +91-571-2700920 (Extension 1178) on working days during office hours

content_sections.heading: AMU Assistant Professor (Temporary) Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Assistant Professor (Temporary).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Each Application Form: Rs. 500 (non-refundable). PwD candidates who upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma: Exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Postgraduate degree in the concerned specialty or subject from a recognized university, included in the Second Schedule of the Indian Medicine Central Council Act, 1970 or recognized under section 35 of the Act, with valid State or Central/National registration (as per Gazette Notification No. 764 dated 26th September, 2024). The candidate must have qualified the National Teachers Eligibility Test conducted by NCISM. No teaching experience is required.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Post is reserved for the 'OH' category of PwD candidates. PwD applicants must have at least 40% of the relevant disability, with a Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-I). Indian Nationals, including OCI Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955, may apply. Candidates with an NCISM Teacher's Code must provide it at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete application forms or applications on plain paper will be summarily rejected. Forms without self-attested copies of the required documents will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny and short-listing of applications. Interview. The University may constitute a Committee to scrutinize applications and short-list applicants. Call letters for interview will be sent only to short-listed applicants.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary post against the post of Professor vacated by Professor Iqtidarul Hasan Zaidi (Retired).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Department of Tashreeh-wa-Munafeual Aza, Faculty of Unani Medicine, Ajmal Khan Tibbiya College, AMU, Aligarh.
